query.description: Search query for EV charging stations. Can be a station name or brand (e.g., 'Tesla Supercharger', 'ChargePoint'). Leave empty to find all nearby stations.

position.description: Center position as [longitude, latitude] for EV station search (GeoJSON convention). Required for location-based results. Example: [4.89707, 52.377956] for Amsterdam.

radius.description: Search radius in meters. Default: 5000 (5km). Examples: 1000 (walking), 5000 (local), 20000 (wide area).

connectorTypes.description: Filter by EV connector types. includeAvailability.description: Include real-time charger availability data (available/occupied/out-of-service counts per connector). Default: true.

language.description: Language for results (IETF tag). Examples: 'en-US', 'de-DE', 'fr-FR'.

countries.description: Limit results to countries (ISO alpha-2 codes). Example: ['US'], ['DE', 'FR'].

show_ui.description: Request the interactive map widget. Only hosts that support MCP Apps render it, and it returns no coordinates to the caller. Default: false

function.name: tomtom-routing
function.description: Calculate optimal routes between two locations. The primary tool for directions, routes, travel time, or distance between places (e.g. 'route from Amsterdam to Berlin', 'how long to drive from A to B'). Returns turn-by-turn directions, distance, travel time, and a map image. Multi-stop routes with 3+ waypoints are handled by tomtom-waypoint-routing; visualizing multiple routes or combining routes with markers/polygons on a single map image is handled by tomtom-dynamic-map.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to +90). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to +180). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

origin.description: Starting point coordinates. Obtain from geocoding for best results.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to +90). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to +180). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

destination.description: Destination coordinates. Obtain from geocoding for best results.

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): trimmed response with essential fields only, saves tokens. 'full': complete API response with all fields including coordinates, classifications, etc.

traffic.description: Include real-time traffic data for more accurate ETAs and route suggestions.

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. May increase travel time. Options: 'tollRoads','motorways','ferries','unpavedRoads','carpools','alreadyUsedRoads'. Accepts array of string(s).

departAt.description: Departure time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T14:30:00Z'). Cannot be used with arriveAt.

arriveAt.description: Arrival time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T17:00:00Z'). Cannot be used with departAt.

maxAlternatives.description: Number of alternative routes (0-5). More alternatives = more options but larger response.

alternativeType.description: When maxAlternatives is greater than 0, it allows the definition of computing alternative routes: finding routes that are significantly different from the reference route, or finding routes that are better than the reference route. Possible values are: `anyRoute` (returns alternative routes that are significantly different from the reference route.), `betterRoute` (only returns alternative routes that are better than the reference route, according to the given planning criteria (set by routeType). If there is a road block on the reference route, then any alternative that does not contain any blockages will be considered a better route. The summary in the route response will contain information (see the planningReason parameter) about the reason for the better alternative.) Note: The betterRoute value can only be used when reconstructing a reference route. Default value: `anyRoute` Other values: `betterRoute`

language.description: Language code for instructions (e.g., 'en-US', 'de-DE').

computeBestOrder.description: Reorder waypoints for optimization. Use with multiple waypoints to find the most efficient route order.

supportingPoints.description: Additional coordinates that influence the route shape without being stops (format: 'lat,lon;lat,lon').

vehicleHeading.description: Heading of the vehicle in degrees (0-359) for more accurate initial routing.

includeTollPaymentTypes.description: Include toll payment types in the toll section. If a toll section has different toll payment types in its subsections, this toll section is split into multiple toll sections with the toll payment types. Possible values: all(Include toll payment types in the toll section.), none (Do not include toll payment types in the toll section). The value `all` must be used together with sectionType=toll. Default value: none

report.description: Specifies which data should be reported for diagnostic purposes. A possible value is: `effectiveSettings`. Reports the effective parameters or data used when calling the API. In the case of defaulted parameters, the default will be reflected where the parameter was not specified by the caller. Default value: effectiveSettings

routeRepresentation.description: Representation of routes in response: 'polyline' (default, includes points), 'encodedPolyline' (compressed format), 'summaryOnly' (no points), 'none' (with computeBestOrder only). It cannot be used when `maxAlternatives` is set

extendedRouteRepresentation.description: Additional routing data formats to include in the response.

computeTravelTimeFor.description: Calculate travel times for all segments ('all') or none ('none').

hilliness.description: Preference for avoiding hills. Use 'low' for flatter routes.

windingness.description: Preference for avoiding winding roads. Use 'low' for straighter routes.

vehicleMaxSpeed.description: Maximum vehicle speed in km/h for commercial routing.

vehicleWeight.description: Vehicle weight in kg. Important for truck routing restrictions.

vehicleWidth.description: Vehicle width in meters. Used to avoid narrow roads.

vehicleHeight.description: Vehicle height in meters. Used to avoid low bridges.

vehicleLength.description: Vehicle length in meters. Affects maneuverability restrictions.

vehicleCommercial.description: Commercial vehicle flag. Affects road access restrictions.

vehicleAxleWeight.description: Vehicle axle weight in kg for weight-restricted roads.

vehicleNumberOfAxles.description: Number of axles on the vehicle. Used for toll calculations and restrictions.

vehicleLoadType.description: Cargo type for hazardous materials routing.

vehicleAdrTunnelRestrictionCode.description: ADR tunnel restriction code for hazardous materials.

vehicleEngineType.description: Engine type for fuel/energy consumption calculation.

currentChargeInkWh.description: Current EV battery charge in kWh. Required for EV routing.

maxChargeInkWh.description: Maximum EV battery capacity in kWh. Required for EV routing.

constantSpeedConsumptionInkWhPerHundredk.description: EV speed-to-consumption mappings format: '50,8.2:130,21.3' (speed in km/h, consumption in kWh/100km).

auxiliaryPowerInkW.description: Auxiliary power consumption in kW for electric vehicles.

chargeMarginsInkWh.description: Comma-separated charge margins in kWh for route planning.

constantSpeedConsumptionInLitersPerHundr.description: Combustion speed-to-consumption mappings: '50,6.3:130,11.5' (speed in km/h, consumption in L/100km).

currentFuelInLiters.description: Current fuel level in liters for combustion vehicles.

auxiliaryPowerInLitersPerHour.description: Auxiliary power consumption for combustion vehicles in L/hr.

fuelEnergyDensityInMJoulesPerLiter.description: Fuel energy density in megajoules per liter.

consumptionInkWhPerkmAltitudeGain.description: Energy used per km of altitude gain.

recuperationInkWhPerkmAltitudeLoss.description: Energy recovered per km of altitude loss.

sectionType.description: Highlight specific road section types in response for route analysis: toll (toll roads), motorway (highways), tunnel, urban (city areas), country (rural areas), pedestrian (walking paths), etc.

function.name: tomtom-traffic
function.description: Find traffic incidents in an area. The primary tool for questions about traffic, accidents, road closures, congestion, or dangerous road conditions. Returns severity, description, delay and affected roads for each incident. Incident locations are omitted unless response_detail is 'geometry'.

show_ui.description: Request the interactive map widget. Only hosts that support MCP Apps render it, and it returns no coordinates to the caller. Default: false

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): essential fields and point coordinates, no geometry. 'geometry': compact plus a 'geometry' key holding a GeoJSON FeatureCollection ([lon, lat], at most 1,000 vertices per feature); use this to get coordinates to draw or process. 'full': the raw API response, lossless and many times larger.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] (GeoJSON convention). Example: [-74.02, 40.70, -73.96, 40.80] for lower Manhattan. Use smaller areas for better results.

language.description: Language for incident descriptions: 'en-GB', 'de-DE', 'fr-FR', 'es-ES'. Default: 'en-GB'.

categoryFilter.description: Filter by incident categories (comma-separated): '0' (Accident), '1' (Fog), '2' (Dangerous Conditions), '3' (Rain), '4' (Ice), '5' (Lane Restrictions), '6' (Lane Closure), '7' (Road Closure), '8' (Road Works), '9' (Wind), '10' (Flooding), '11' (Detour), '14' (Cluster).

timeValidityFilter.description: Filter incidents by occurrence time. Values: 'present' (current incidents), 'future' (planned incidents). Multiple values comma-separated. Default: 'present'.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of incidents to return (1-1000). Default: 100. When more incidents match, the most severe are returned and the response includes an incidentSummary with full totals.

fields.description: Fields to include in response, nested as in response schema. Default: basic incident data. For all fields use full object notation with incidents{type,geometry{type,coordinates},properties{...}}.

function.name: tomtom-poi-categories
function.description: Look up POI category codes from natural language. The poiCategories parameter of the search tools accepts only codes returned by this tool. Category codes are UPPER_SNAKE_CASE text strings (e.g. 'ITALIAN_RESTAURANT', 'PARKING_GARAGE'), not numeric IDs. Workflow: (1) extract the user's intent as keywords (e.g. 'italian restaurants in Amsterdam' → filters: ['italian restaurant']); (2) call this tool with those keywords in the filters parameter; (3) pass the returned category codes in the poiCategories parameter of search tools (fuzzy-search, poi-search, nearby, area-search). Guessed or hardcoded category codes are unreliable; this tool is the source of valid codes.

filters.description: Keywords to filter categories by name or synonym. Each keyword is matched as a substring against category names. Results from all keywords are merged and deduplicated. Examples: ['gym'], ['italian restaurant'], ['parking', 'garage']. Omit to return all available POI categories.

function.name: tomtom-routing
function.description: Calculate optimal routes between two locations. The primary tool for directions, routes, travel time, or distance between places (e.g. 'route from Amsterdam to Berlin', 'how long to drive from A to B'). Returns turn-by-turn directions, distance, travel time, and a map image. Multi-stop routes with 3+ waypoints are handled by tomtom-waypoint-routing; visualizing multiple routes or combining routes with markers/polygons on a single map image is handled by tomtom-dynamic-map.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to +90). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to +180). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

origin.description: Starting point coordinates. Obtain from geocoding for best results.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to +90). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to +180). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

destination.description: Destination coordinates. Obtain from geocoding for best results.

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): trimmed response with essential fields only, saves tokens. 'full': complete API response with all fields including coordinates, classifications, etc.

traffic.description: Include real-time traffic data for more accurate ETAs and route suggestions.

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. May increase travel time. Options: 'tollRoads','motorways','ferries','unpavedRoads','carpools','alreadyUsedRoads'. Accepts array of string(s).

departAt.description: Departure time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T14:30:00Z'). Cannot be used with arriveAt.

arriveAt.description: Arrival time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T17:00:00Z'). Cannot be used with departAt.

maxAlternatives.description: Number of alternative routes (0-5). More alternatives = more options but larger response.

alternativeType.description: When maxAlternatives is greater than 0, it allows the definition of computing alternative routes: finding routes that are significantly different from the reference route, or finding routes that are better than the reference route. Possible values are: `anyRoute` (returns alternative routes that are significantly different from the reference route.), `betterRoute` (only returns alternative routes that are better than the reference route, according to the given planning criteria (set by routeType). If there is a road block on the reference route, then any alternative that does not contain any blockages will be considered a better route. The summary in the route response will contain information (see the planningReason parameter) about the reason for the better alternative.) Note: The betterRoute value can only be used when reconstructing a reference route. Default value: `anyRoute` Other values: `betterRoute`

language.description: Language code for instructions (e.g., 'en-US', 'de-DE').

computeBestOrder.description: Reorder waypoints for optimization. Use with multiple waypoints to find the most efficient route order.

supportingPoints.description: Additional coordinates that influence the route shape without being stops (format: 'lat,lon;lat,lon').

vehicleHeading.description: Heading of the vehicle in degrees (0-359) for more accurate initial routing.

includeTollPaymentTypes.description: Include toll payment types in the toll section. If a toll section has different toll payment types in its subsections, this toll section is split into multiple toll sections with the toll payment types. Possible values: all(Include toll payment types in the toll section.), none (Do not include toll payment types in the toll section). The value `all` must be used together with sectionType=toll. Default value: none

report.description: Specifies which data should be reported for diagnostic purposes. A possible value is: `effectiveSettings`. Reports the effective parameters or data used when calling the API. In the case of defaulted parameters, the default will be reflected where the parameter was not specified by the caller. Default value: effectiveSettings

routeRepresentation.description: Representation of routes in response: 'polyline' (default, includes points), 'encodedPolyline' (compressed format), 'summaryOnly' (no points), 'none' (with computeBestOrder only). It cannot be used when `maxAlternatives` is set

extendedRouteRepresentation.description: Additional routing data formats to include in the response.

computeTravelTimeFor.description: Calculate travel times for all segments ('all') or none ('none').

hilliness.description: Preference for avoiding hills. Use 'low' for flatter routes.

windingness.description: Preference for avoiding winding roads. Use 'low' for straighter routes.

vehicleMaxSpeed.description: Maximum vehicle speed in km/h for commercial routing.

vehicleWeight.description: Vehicle weight in kg. Important for truck routing restrictions.

vehicleWidth.description: Vehicle width in meters. Used to avoid narrow roads.

vehicleHeight.description: Vehicle height in meters. Used to avoid low bridges.

vehicleLength.description: Vehicle length in meters. Affects maneuverability restrictions.

vehicleCommercial.description: Commercial vehicle flag. Affects road access restrictions.

vehicleAxleWeight.description: Vehicle axle weight in kg for weight-restricted roads.

vehicleNumberOfAxles.description: Number of axles on the vehicle. Used for toll calculations and restrictions.

vehicleLoadType.description: Cargo type for hazardous materials routing.

vehicleAdrTunnelRestrictionCode.description: ADR tunnel restriction code for hazardous materials.

vehicleEngineType.description: Engine type for fuel/energy consumption calculation.

maxChargeInkWh.description: Maximum EV battery capacity in kWh. Required for EV routing.

constantSpeedConsumptionInkWhPerHundredk.description: EV speed-to-consumption mappings format: '50,8.2:130,21.3' (speed in km/h, consumption in kWh/100km).

auxiliaryPowerInkW.description: Auxiliary power consumption in kW for electric vehicles.

chargeMarginsInkWh.description: Comma-separated charge margins in kWh for route planning.

constantSpeedConsumptionInLitersPerHundr.description: Combustion speed-to-consumption mappings: '50,6.3:130,11.5' (speed in km/h, consumption in L/100km).

currentFuelInLiters.description: Current fuel level in liters for combustion vehicles.

auxiliaryPowerInLitersPerHour.description: Auxiliary power consumption for combustion vehicles in L/hr.

fuelEnergyDensityInMJoulesPerLiter.description: Fuel energy density in megajoules per liter.

consumptionInkWhPerkmAltitudeGain.description: Energy used per km of altitude gain.

recuperationInkWhPerkmAltitudeLoss.description: Energy recovered per km of altitude loss.

sectionType.description: Highlight specific road section types in response for route analysis: toll (toll roads), motorway (highways), tunnel, urban (city areas), country (rural areas), pedestrian (walking paths), etc.

function.description: Calculate optimal routes between two locations. The primary tool for directions, routes, travel time, or distance between places (e.g. 'route from Amsterdam to Berlin', 'how long to drive from A to B'). Returns turn-by-turn directions, distance, travel time, and a map image. Multi-stop routes with 3+ waypoints are handled by tomtom-waypoint-routing; visualizing multiple routes or combining routes with markers/polygons on a single map image is handled by tomtom-dynamic-map.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to +90). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

function.name: tomtom-routing
function.description: Calculate optimal routes between two locations. The primary tool for directions, routes, travel time, or distance between places (e.g. 'route from Amsterdam to Berlin', 'how long to drive from A to B'). Returns turn-by-turn directions, distance, travel time, and a map image. Multi-stop routes with 3+ waypoints are handled by tomtom-waypoint-routing; visualizing multiple routes or combining routes with markers/polygons on a single map image is handled by tomtom-dynamic-map.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to +90). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to +180). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

origin.description: Starting point coordinates. Obtain from geocoding for best results.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to +90). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to +180). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

destination.description: Destination coordinates. Obtain from geocoding for best results.

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): trimmed response with essential fields only, saves tokens. 'full': complete API response with all fields including coordinates, classifications, etc.

traffic.description: Include real-time traffic data for more accurate ETAs and route suggestions.

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. May increase travel time. Options: 'tollRoads','motorways','ferries','unpavedRoads','carpools','alreadyUsedRoads'. Accepts array of string(s).

departAt.description: Departure time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T14:30:00Z'). Cannot be used with arriveAt.

arriveAt.description: Arrival time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T17:00:00Z'). Cannot be used with departAt.

maxAlternatives.description: Number of alternative routes (0-5). More alternatives = more options but larger response.

alternativeType.description: When maxAlternatives is greater than 0, it allows the definition of computing alternative routes: finding routes that are significantly different from the reference route, or finding routes that are better than the reference route. Possible values are: `anyRoute` (returns alternative routes that are significantly different from the reference route.), `betterRoute` (only returns alternative routes that are better than the reference route, according to the given planning criteria (set by routeType). If there is a road block on the reference route, then any alternative that does not contain any blockages will be considered a better route. The summary in the route response will contain information (see the planningReason parameter) about the reason for the better alternative.) Note: The betterRoute value can only be used when reconstructing a reference route. Default value: `anyRoute` Other values: `betterRoute`

language.description: Language code for instructions (e.g., 'en-US', 'de-DE').

computeBestOrder.description: Reorder waypoints for optimization. Use with multiple waypoints to find the most efficient route order.

supportingPoints.description: Additional coordinates that influence the route shape without being stops (format: 'lat,lon;lat,lon').

vehicleHeading.description: Heading of the vehicle in degrees (0-359) for more accurate initial routing.

includeTollPaymentTypes.description: Include toll payment types in the toll section. If a toll section has different toll payment types in its subsections, this toll section is split into multiple toll sections with the toll payment types. Possible values: all(Include toll payment types in the toll section.), none (Do not include toll payment types in the toll section). The value `all` must be used together with sectionType=toll. Default value: none

report.description: Specifies which data should be reported for diagnostic purposes. A possible value is: `effectiveSettings`. Reports the effective parameters or data used when calling the API. In the case of defaulted parameters, the default will be reflected where the parameter was not specified by the caller. Default value: effectiveSettings

routeRepresentation.description: Representation of routes in response: 'polyline' (default, includes points), 'encodedPolyline' (compressed format), 'summaryOnly' (no points), 'none' (with computeBestOrder only). It cannot be used when `maxAlternatives` is set

extendedRouteRepresentation.description: Additional routing data formats to include in the response.

computeTravelTimeFor.description: Calculate travel times for all segments ('all') or none ('none').

hilliness.description: Preference for avoiding hills. Use 'low' for flatter routes.

windingness.description: Preference for avoiding winding roads. Use 'low' for straighter routes.

vehicleMaxSpeed.description: Maximum vehicle speed in km/h for commercial routing.

vehicleWeight.description: Vehicle weight in kg. Important for truck routing restrictions.

vehicleWidth.description: Vehicle width in meters. Used to avoid narrow roads.

vehicleHeight.description: Vehicle height in meters. Used to avoid low bridges.

vehicleLength.description: Vehicle length in meters. Affects maneuverability restrictions.

vehicleCommercial.description: Commercial vehicle flag. Affects road access restrictions.

vehicleAxleWeight.description: Vehicle axle weight in kg for weight-restricted roads.

vehicleNumberOfAxles.description: Number of axles on the vehicle. Used for toll calculations and restrictions.

vehicleLoadType.description: Cargo type for hazardous materials routing.

vehicleAdrTunnelRestrictionCode.description: ADR tunnel restriction code for hazardous materials.

vehicleEngineType.description: Engine type for fuel/energy consumption calculation.

currentChargeInkWh.description: Current EV battery charge in kWh. Required for EV routing.

maxChargeInkWh.description: Maximum EV battery capacity in kWh. Required for EV routing.

constantSpeedConsumptionInkWhPerHundredk.description: EV speed-to-consumption mappings format: '50,8.2:130,21.3' (speed in km/h, consumption in kWh/100km).

function.name: tomtom-routing
function.description: Calculate optimal routes through an ordered list of locations [origin, ...stops, destination]. The primary tool for directions, routes, travel time, or distance between places — whether a simple A-to-B or a multi-stop itinerary (e.g. 'route from Amsterdam to Berlin', 'drive from A to B via C and D'). Returns distance, travel time and traffic delay, with a summary per leg. Turn-by-turn instructions are not available. Route polylines are omitted unless response_detail is 'geometry'.

items.description: Position as [longitude, latitude] (GeoJSON convention, lng first). Example: [4.89707, 52.377956] for Amsterdam, [13.404954, 52.520008] for Berlin.

locations.description: Ordered list of coordinates [origin, ...intermediateStops, destination]. Minimum 2 (origin + destination); add intermediate positions for multi-stop routes. Use geocoding for accurate coordinates.

show_ui.description: Request the interactive map widget. Only hosts that support MCP Apps render it, and it returns no coordinates to the caller. Default: false

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): essential fields and point coordinates, no geometry. 'geometry': compact plus a 'geometry' key holding a GeoJSON FeatureCollection ([lon, lat], at most 1,000 vertices per feature); use this to get coordinates to draw or process. 'full': the raw API response, lossless and many times larger.

traffic.description: Traffic consideration: 'live' (real-time + historical), 'historical' (historical only).

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. May increase travel time. Options: 'tollRoads','motorways','ferries','unpavedRoads','carpools','alreadyUsedRoads'. Accepts array of string(s).

departAt.description: Departure time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T14:30:00Z'). Cannot be used with arriveAt.

arriveAt.description: Arrival time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T17:00:00Z'). Cannot be used with departAt.

maxAlternatives.description: Number of alternative routes (0-5). More alternatives = more options but larger response.

alternativeType.description: When maxAlternatives is greater than 0, it allows the definition of computing alternative routes: finding routes that are significantly different from the reference route, or finding routes that are better than the reference route. Possible values are: `anyRoute` (returns alternative routes that are significantly different from the reference route.), `betterRoute` (only returns alternative routes that are better than the reference route, according to the given planning criteria (set by routeType). If there is a road block on the reference route, then any alternative that does not contain any blockages will be considered a better route. The summary in the route response will contain information (see the planningReason parameter) about the reason for the better alternative.) Note: The betterRoute value can only be used when reconstructing a reference route. Default value: `anyRoute` Other values: `betterRoute`

supportingPoints.description: Additional coordinates that influence the route shape without being stops (format: 'lat,lon;lat,lon').

vehicleHeading.description: Heading of the vehicle in degrees (0-359) for more accurate initial routing.

routeRepresentation.description: Representation of routes in response: 'polyline' (default, includes points), 'encodedPolyline' (compressed format), 'summaryOnly' (no points), 'none' (with computeBestOrder only). It cannot be used when `maxAlternatives` is set

extendedRouteRepresentation.description: Additional routing data formats to include in the response.

minDeviationDistance.description: Minimum distance (meters) alternatives must follow the reference route from origin.

minDeviationTime.description: Minimum time (seconds) alternatives must follow the reference route from origin.

supportingPointIndexOfOrigin.description: Index hint for disambiguating polyline origin point (0 to polyline size - 1).

reconstructionMode.description: How to reconstruct polyline: 'track' (flexible), 'route' (close match), 'update' (ignore restrictions).

vehicleMaxSpeed.description: Maximum vehicle speed in km/h for commercial routing.

vehicleWeight.description: Vehicle weight in kg. Required by the efficiency parameters.

vehicleEngineType.description: Engine type for fuel/energy consumption calculation.

currentChargeInkWh.description: Current EV battery charge in kWh. Required for EV routing.

maxChargeInkWh.description: Maximum EV battery capacity in kWh. Required for EV routing.

constantSpeedConsumptionInkWhPerHundredk.description: EV speed-to-consumption mappings format: '50,8.2:130,21.3' (speed in km/h, consumption in kWh/100km).

auxiliaryPowerInkW.description: Auxiliary power consumption in kW for electric vehicles.

constantSpeedConsumptionInLitersPerHundr.description: Combustion speed-to-consumption mappings format: '50,6.5:130,11.5' (speed in km/h, consumption in L/100km). Required for combustion engine fuel budget calculations.

currentFuelInLiters.description: Current fuel level in liters for combustion vehicles.

auxiliaryPowerInLitersPerHour.description: Auxiliary power consumption for combustion vehicles in L/hr.

fuelEnergyDensityInMJoulesPerLiter.description: Fuel energy density in megajoules per liter.

vehicleHasElectricTollCollectionTranspon.description: ETC transponder availability: 'all' (has transponder), 'none' (avoid ETC-only roads).

uphillEfficiency.description: Efficiency during uphill driving (0-1). Requires vehicleWeight.

downhillEfficiency.description: Efficiency during downhill driving (0-1). Requires vehicleWeight.

consumptionInkWhPerkmAltitudeGain.description: Energy used per km of altitude gain.

recuperationInkWhPerkmAltitudeLoss.description: Energy recovered per km of altitude loss.

sectionType.description: Highlight specific road section types in response for route analysis: toll (toll roads), motorway (highways), tunnel, urban (city areas), country (rural areas), pedestrian (walking paths), etc.

function.name: tomtom-routing
function.description: Calculate optimal routes through an ordered list of locations [origin, ...stops, destination]. The primary tool for directions, routes, travel time, or distance between places — whether a simple A-to-B or a multi-stop itinerary (e.g. 'route from Amsterdam to Berlin', 'drive from A to B via C and D'). Returns distance, travel time and traffic delay, with a summary per leg. Turn-by-turn instructions are not available. Route polylines are omitted unless response_detail is 'geometry'.

items.description: Position as [longitude, latitude] (GeoJSON convention, lng first). Example: [4.89707, 52.377956] for Amsterdam, [13.404954, 52.520008] for Berlin.

locations.description: Ordered list of coordinates [origin, ...intermediateStops, destination]. Minimum 2 (origin + destination); add intermediate positions for multi-stop routes. Use geocoding for accurate coordinates.

show_ui.description: Request the interactive map widget. Only hosts that support MCP Apps render it, and it returns no coordinates to the caller. Default: false

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): essential fields and point coordinates, no geometry. 'geometry': compact plus a 'geometry' key holding a GeoJSON FeatureCollection ([lon, lat], at most 1,000 vertices per feature); use this to get coordinates to draw or process. 'full': the raw API response, lossless and many times larger.

traffic.description: Traffic consideration: 'live' (real-time + historical), 'historical' (historical only).

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. May increase travel time. Options: 'tollRoads','motorways','ferries','unpavedRoads','carpools','alreadyUsedRoads'. Accepts array of string(s).

departAt.description: Departure time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T14:30:00Z'). Cannot be used with arriveAt.

arriveAt.description: Arrival time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T17:00:00Z'). Cannot be used with departAt.

maxAlternatives.description: Number of alternative routes (0-5). More alternatives = more options but larger response.

alternativeType.description: When maxAlternatives is greater than 0, it allows the definition of computing alternative routes: finding routes that are significantly different from the reference route, or finding routes that are better than the reference route. Possible values are: `anyRoute` (returns alternative routes that are significantly different from the reference route.), `betterRoute` (only returns alternative routes that are better than the reference route, according to the given planning criteria (set by routeType). If there is a road block on the reference route, then any alternative that does not contain any blockages will be considered a better route. The summary in the route response will contain information (see the planningReason parameter) about the reason for the better alternative.) Note: The betterRoute value can only be used when reconstructing a reference route. Default value: `anyRoute` Other values: `betterRoute`

supportingPoints.description: Additional coordinates that influence the route shape without being stops (format: 'lat,lon;lat,lon').

vehicleHeading.description: Heading of the vehicle in degrees (0-359) for more accurate initial routing.

routeRepresentation.description: Representation of routes in response: 'polyline' (default, includes points), 'encodedPolyline' (compressed format), 'summaryOnly' (no points), 'none' (with computeBestOrder only). It cannot be used when `maxAlternatives` is set

extendedRouteRepresentation.description: Additional routing data formats to include in the response.

minDeviationDistance.description: Minimum distance (meters) alternatives must follow the reference route from origin.

minDeviationTime.description: Minimum time (seconds) alternatives must follow the reference route from origin.

supportingPointIndexOfOrigin.description: Index hint for disambiguating polyline origin point (0 to polyline size - 1).

reconstructionMode.description: How to reconstruct polyline: 'track' (flexible), 'route' (close match), 'update' (ignore restrictions).

vehicleMaxSpeed.description: Maximum vehicle speed in km/h for commercial routing.

vehicleWeight.description: Vehicle weight in kg. Required by the efficiency parameters.

vehicleEngineType.description: Engine type for fuel/energy consumption calculation.

currentChargeInkWh.description: Current EV battery charge in kWh. Required for EV routing.

maxChargeInkWh.description: Maximum EV battery capacity in kWh. Required for EV routing.

constantSpeedConsumptionInkWhPerHundredk.description: EV speed-to-consumption mappings format: '50,8.2:130,21.3' (speed in km/h, consumption in kWh/100km).

auxiliaryPowerInkW.description: Auxiliary power consumption in kW for electric vehicles.

constantSpeedConsumptionInLitersPerHundr.description: Combustion speed-to-consumption mappings format: '50,6.5:130,11.5' (speed in km/h, consumption in L/100km). Required for combustion engine fuel budget calculations.

currentFuelInLiters.description: Current fuel level in liters for combustion vehicles.

auxiliaryPowerInLitersPerHour.description: Auxiliary power consumption for combustion vehicles in L/hr.

fuelEnergyDensityInMJoulesPerLiter.description: Fuel energy density in megajoules per liter.

vehicleHasElectricTollCollectionTranspon.description: ETC transponder availability: 'all' (has transponder), 'none' (avoid ETC-only roads).

uphillEfficiency.description: Efficiency during uphill driving (0-1). Requires vehicleWeight.

downhillEfficiency.description: Efficiency during downhill driving (0-1). Requires vehicleWeight.

consumptionInkWhPerkmAltitudeGain.description: Energy used per km of altitude gain.

recuperationInkWhPerkmAltitudeLoss.description: Energy recovered per km of altitude loss.

sectionType.description: Highlight specific road section types in response for route analysis: toll (toll roads), motorway (highways), tunnel, urban (city areas), country (rural areas), pedestrian (walking paths), etc.

utterance: Hallo, ich würde gerne mit meinem Elektroauto von Chennai nach Kovūr fahren. Bitte finde mir eine Route, bei der ich unterwegs zwischendurch aufladen kann, aber unbedingt ohne Autobahn.

function.name: tomtom-traffic
function.description: Find traffic incidents in an area. The primary tool for questions about traffic, accidents, road closures, congestion, or dangerous road conditions. Returns severity, description, delay and affected roads for each incident. Incident locations are omitted unless response_detail is 'geometry'.

show_ui.description: Request the interactive map widget. Only hosts that support MCP Apps render it, and it returns no coordinates to the caller. Default: false

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): essential fields and point coordinates, no geometry. 'geometry': compact plus a 'geometry' key holding a GeoJSON FeatureCollection ([lon, lat], at most 1,000 vertices per feature); use this to get coordinates to draw or process. 'full': the raw API response, lossless and many times larger.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] (GeoJSON convention). Example: [-74.02, 40.70, -73.96, 40.80] for lower Manhattan. Use smaller areas for better results.

language.description: Language for incident descriptions: 'en-GB', 'de-DE', 'fr-FR', 'es-ES'. Default: 'en-GB'.

categoryFilter.description: Filter by incident categories (comma-separated): '0' (Accident), '1' (Fog), '2' (Dangerous Conditions), '3' (Rain), '4' (Ice), '5' (Lane Restrictions), '6' (Lane Closure), '7' (Road Closure), '8' (Road Works), '9' (Wind), '10' (Flooding), '11' (Detour), '14' (Cluster).

timeValidityFilter.description: Filter incidents by occurrence time. Values: 'present' (current incidents), 'future' (planned incidents). Multiple values comma-separated. Default: 'present'.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of incidents to return (1-1000). Default: 100. When more incidents match, the most severe are returned and the response includes an incidentSummary with full totals.

fields.description: Fields to include in response, nested as in response schema. Default: basic incident data. For all fields use full object notation with incidents{type,geometry{type,coordinates},properties{...}}.

timeZone.description: Used to indicate the mode in which the timeZone object should be returned. Values: iana Mode shows the IANA ID which allows the user to determine the current time zone for the POI. Usage examples: timeZone=iana

geometries.description: Include geometries information in the response

addressRanges.description: Include address ranges in the response

lat.description: Center latitude for location bias

lon.description: Center longitude for location bias

radius.description: Search radius in meters when lat/lon provided

topLeft.description: Top-left coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with btmRight

btmRight.description: Bottom-right coordinates of bounding box (format: 'lat,lon'). Must be used with topLeft

entityTypeSet.description:

function.name: tomtom-waypoint-routing
function.description: Plan multi-stop routes through 3 or more waypoints. Use when the user needs to visit multiple locations in sequence (e.g. 'route from A to B via C and D'). Returns optimized turn-by-turn directions, total distance, and travel time. For simple A-to-B routes, use tomtom-routing instead.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to +90). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to +180). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

waypoints.description: Ordered array of waypoint coordinates (minimum 2). Route calculated in exact sequence provided. Use geocoding for accurate coordinates.

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): trimmed response with essential fields only, saves tokens. 'full': complete API response with all fields including coordinates, classifications, etc.

traffic.description: Include real-time traffic data for more accurate ETAs and route suggestions.

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. May increase travel time. Options: 'tollRoads','motorways','ferries','unpavedRoads','carpools','alreadyUsedRoads'. Accepts array of string(s).

departAt.description: Departure time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T14:30:00Z'). Cannot be used with arriveAt.

arriveAt.description: Arrival time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T17:00:00Z'). Cannot be used with departAt.

maxAlternatives.description: Number of alternative routes (0-5). More alternatives = more options but larger response.

alternativeType.description: When maxAlternatives is greater than 0, it allows the definition of computing alternative routes: finding routes that are significantly different from the reference route, or finding routes that are better than the reference route. Possible values are: `anyRoute` (returns alternative routes that are significantly different from the reference route.), `betterRoute` (only returns alternative routes that are better than the reference route, according to the given planning criteria (set by routeType). If there is a road block on the reference route, then any alternative that does not contain any blockages will be considered a better route. The summary in the route response will contain information (see the planningReason parameter) about the reason for the better alternative.) Note: The betterRoute value can only be used when reconstructing a reference route. Default value: `anyRoute` Other values: `betterRoute`

language.description: Language code for instructions (e.g., 'en-US', 'de-DE').

computeBestOrder.description: Reorder waypoints for optimization. Use with multiple waypoints to find the most efficient route order.

supportingPoints.description: Additional coordinates that influence the route shape without being stops (format: 'lat,lon;lat,lon').

vehicleHeading.description: Heading of the vehicle in degrees (0-359) for more accurate initial routing.

includeTollPaymentTypes.description: Include toll payment types in the toll section. If a toll section has different toll payment types in its subsections, this toll section is split into multiple toll sections with the toll payment types. Possible values: all(Include toll payment types in the toll section.), none (Do not include toll payment types in the toll section). The value `all` must be used together with sectionType=toll. Default value: none

report.description: Specifies which data should be reported for diagnostic purposes. A possible value is: `effectiveSettings`. Reports the effective parameters or data used when calling the API. In the case of defaulted parameters, the default will be reflected where the parameter was not specified by the caller. Default value: effectiveSettings

routeRepresentation.description: Representation of routes in response: 'polyline' (default, includes points), 'encodedPolyline' (compressed format), 'summaryOnly' (no points), 'none' (with computeBestOrder only). It cannot be used when `maxAlternatives` is set

extendedRouteRepresentation.description: Additional routing data formats to include in the response.

computeTravelTimeFor.description: Calculate travel times for all segments ('all') or none ('none').

hilliness.description: Preference for avoiding hills. Use 'low' for flatter routes.

windingness.description: Preference for avoiding winding roads. Use 'low' for straighter routes.

vehicleMaxSpeed.description: Maximum vehicle speed in km/h for commercial routing.

vehicleWeight.description: Vehicle weight in kg. Important for truck routing restrictions.

vehicleWidth.description: Vehicle width in meters. Used to avoid narrow roads.

vehicleHeight.description: Vehicle height in meters. Used to avoid low bridges.

vehicleLength.description: Vehicle length in meters. Affects maneuverability restrictions.

vehicleCommercial.description: Commercial vehicle flag. Affects road access restrictions.

vehicleAxleWeight.description: Vehicle axle weight in kg for weight-restricted roads.

vehicleNumberOfAxles.description: Number of axles on the vehicle. Used for toll calculations and restrictions.

vehicleLoadType.description: Cargo type for hazardous materials routing.

vehicleAdrTunnelRestrictionCode.description: ADR tunnel restriction code for hazardous materials.

vehicleEngineType.description: Engine type for fuel/energy consumption calculation.

currentChargeInkWh.description: Current EV battery charge in kWh. Required for EV routing.

maxChargeInkWh.description: Maximum EV battery capacity in kWh. Required for EV routing.

constantSpeedConsumptionInkWhPerHundredk.description: EV speed-to-consumption mappings format: '50,8.2:130,21.3' (speed in km/h, consumption in kWh/100km).

auxiliaryPowerInkW.description: Auxiliary power consumption in kW for electric vehicles.

chargeMarginsInkWh.description: Comma-separated charge margins in kWh for route planning.

constantSpeedConsumptionInLitersPerHundr.description: Combustion speed-to-consumption mappings: '50,6.3:130,11.5' (speed in km/h, consumption in L/100km).

currentFuelInLiters.description: Current fuel level in liters for combustion vehicles.

auxiliaryPowerInLitersPerHour.description: Auxiliary power consumption for combustion vehicles in L/hr.

fuelEnergyDensityInMJoulesPerLiter.description: Fuel energy density in megajoules per liter.

consumptionInkWhPerkmAltitudeGain.description: Energy used per km of altitude gain.

recuperationInkWhPerkmAltitudeLoss.description: Energy recovered per km of altitude loss.

sectionType.description: Road section types to highlight for route analysis. Options: toll (toll roads), motorway (highways), tunnel, urban (city areas), country (rural areas), pedestrian (walking paths), traffic (traffic incidents), toll_road, ferry, travel_mode, important_road_stretch. Accepts array of string(s).

origin.description: Starting point coordinates. Use precise coordinates from geocoding.

destination.description: Destination coordinates. Use precise coordinates from geocoding.

waypoints.description: Optional intermediate waypoints the route should pass through.

items.description: Position as [longitude, latitude] (GeoJSON convention, lng first). Example: [4.89707, 52.377956] for Amsterdam, [13.404954, 52.520008] for Berlin.

currentChargePercent.description: Current battery charge as percentage (0-100). Example: 80 means 80% charged.

maxChargeKWH.description: Maximum battery capacity in kWh. Examples: 40 (Nissan Leaf), 75 (Tesla Model 3 LR), 100 (Tesla Model S).

consumptionInKWH.description: Speed-to-consumption mapping for energy modeling. Example: [{speedKMH:50,consumptionUnitsPer100KM:12},{speedKMH:100,consumptionUnitsPer100KM:18}]. Uses reasonable defaults if not provided.

consumptionUnitsPer100KM.description: Energy consumption in kWh per 100km at this speed.

batteryCurve.description: Battery charging curve defining max charging power at various charge levels. Optional — SDK uses defaults if not provided.

stateOfChargeInkWh.description: Battery level in kWh at this point on the curve.

maxPowerInkW.description: Maximum charging power in kW at this battery level.

minChargeAtDestinationPercent.description: Minimum battery percentage to arrive at destination with. Default: 20%. Higher = more safety buffer.

minChargeAtChargingStopsPercent.description: Minimum battery percentage to arrive at each charging stop with. Default: 10%.

traffic.description: Traffic consideration: 'live' (real-time), 'historical' (patterns only).

avoid.description: Route features to avoid: 'tollRoads', 'motorways', 'ferries', 'unpavedRoads'. Accepts array of string(s).

departAt.description: Departure time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T14:30:00Z').

show_ui.description: Request the interactive map widget. Only hosts that support MCP Apps render it, and it returns no coordinates to the caller. Default: false

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): essential fields and point coordinates, no geometry. 'geometry': compact plus a 'geometry' key holding a GeoJSON FeatureCollection ([lon, lat], at most 1,000 vertices per feature); use this to get coordinates to draw or process. 'full': the raw API response, lossless and many times larger.

query.description: Search query for EV charging stations. Can be a station name or brand (e.g., 'Tesla Supercharger', 'ChargePoint'). Leave empty to find all nearby stations.

position.description: Center position as [longitude, latitude] for EV station search (GeoJSON convention). Required for location-based results. Example: [4.89707, 52.377956] for Amsterdam.

includeAvailability.description: Include real-time charger availability data (available/occupied/out-of-service counts per connector). Default: true.

language.description: Language for results (IETF tag). Examples: 'en-US', 'de-DE', 'fr-FR'.

countries.description: Limit results to countries (ISO alpha-2 codes). Example: ['US'], ['DE', 'FR'].

show_ui.description: Request the interactive map widget. Only hosts that support MCP Apps render it, and it returns no coordinates to the caller. Default: false

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): essential fields and point coordinates, saves tokens. 'full': the raw API response with every field, lossless and much larger.

function.name: tomtom-routing
function.description: Calculate optimal routes through an ordered list of locations [origin, ...stops, destination]. The primary tool for directions, routes, travel time, or distance between places — whether a simple A-to-B or a multi-stop itinerary (e.g. 'route from Amsterdam to Berlin', 'drive from A to B via C and D'). Returns distance, travel time and traffic delay, with a summary per leg. Turn-by-turn instructions are not available. Route polylines are omitted unless response_detail is 'geometry'.

items.description: Position as [longitude, latitude] (GeoJSON convention, lng first). Example: [4.89707, 52.377956] for Amsterdam, [13.404954, 52.520008] for Berlin.

locations.description: Ordered list of coordinates [origin, ...intermediateStops, destination]. Minimum 2 (origin + destination); add intermediate positions for multi-stop routes. Use geocoding for accurate coordinates.

show_ui.description: Request the interactive map widget. Only hosts that support MCP Apps render it, and it returns no coordinates to the caller. Default: false

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): essential fields and point coordinates, no geometry. 'geometry': compact plus a 'geometry' key holding a GeoJSON FeatureCollection ([lon, lat], at most 1,000 vertices per feature); use this to get coordinates to draw or process. 'full': the raw API response, lossless and many times larger.

traffic.description: Traffic consideration: 'live' (real-time + historical), 'historical' (historical only).

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. May increase travel time. Options: 'tollRoads','motorways','ferries','unpavedRoads','carpools','alreadyUsedRoads'. Accepts array of string(s).

departAt.description: Departure time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T14:30:00Z'). Cannot be used with arriveAt.

arriveAt.description: Arrival time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T17:00:00Z'). Cannot be used with departAt.

maxAlternatives.description: Number of alternative routes (0-5). More alternatives = more options but larger response.

alternativeType.description: When maxAlternatives is greater than 0, it allows the definition of computing alternative routes: finding routes that are significantly different from the reference route, or finding routes that are better than the reference route. Possible values are: `anyRoute` (returns alternative routes that are significantly different from the reference route.), `betterRoute` (only returns alternative routes that are better than the reference route, according to the given planning criteria (set by routeType). If there is a road block on the reference route, then any alternative that does not contain any blockages will be considered a better route. The summary in the route response will contain information (see the planningReason parameter) about the reason for the better alternative.) Note: The betterRoute value can only be used when reconstructing a reference route. Default value: `anyRoute` Other values: `betterRoute`

supportingPoints.description: Additional coordinates that influence the route shape without being stops (format: 'lat,lon;lat,lon').

vehicleHeading.description: Heading of the vehicle in degrees (0-359) for more accurate initial routing.

routeRepresentation.description: Representation of routes in response: 'polyline' (default, includes points), 'encodedPolyline' (compressed format), 'summaryOnly' (no points), 'none' (with computeBestOrder only). It cannot be used when `maxAlternatives` is set

extendedRouteRepresentation.description: Additional routing data formats to include in the response.

minDeviationDistance.description: Minimum distance (meters) alternatives must follow the reference route from origin.

minDeviationTime.description: Minimum time (seconds) alternatives must follow the reference route from origin.

supportingPointIndexOfOrigin.description: Index hint for disambiguating polyline origin point (0 to polyline size - 1).

reconstructionMode.description: How to reconstruct polyline: 'track' (flexible), 'route' (close match), 'update' (ignore restrictions).

vehicleMaxSpeed.description: Maximum vehicle speed in km/h for commercial routing.

vehicleWeight.description: Vehicle weight in kg. Required by the efficiency parameters.

vehicleEngineType.description: Engine type for fuel/energy consumption calculation.

currentChargeInkWh.description: Current EV battery charge in kWh. Required for EV routing.

maxChargeInkWh.description: Maximum EV battery capacity in kWh. Required for EV routing.

constantSpeedConsumptionInkWhPerHundredk.description: EV speed-to-consumption mappings format: '50,8.2:130,21.3' (speed in km/h, consumption in kWh/100km).

auxiliaryPowerInkW.description: Auxiliary power consumption in kW for electric vehicles.

constantSpeedConsumptionInLitersPerHundr.description: Combustion speed-to-consumption mappings format: '50,6.5:130,11.5' (speed in km/h, consumption in L/100km). Required for combustion engine fuel budget calculations.

currentFuelInLiters.description: Current fuel level in liters for combustion vehicles.

auxiliaryPowerInLitersPerHour.description: Auxiliary power consumption for combustion vehicles in L/hr.

fuelEnergyDensityInMJoulesPerLiter.description: Fuel energy density in megajoules per liter.

vehicleHasElectricTollCollectionTranspon.description: ETC transponder availability: 'all' (has transponder), 'none' (avoid ETC-only roads).

uphillEfficiency.description: Efficiency during uphill driving (0-1). Requires vehicleWeight.

downhillEfficiency.description: Efficiency during downhill driving (0-1). Requires vehicleWeight.

consumptionInkWhPerkmAltitudeGain.description: Energy used per km of altitude gain.

recuperationInkWhPerkmAltitudeLoss.description: Energy recovered per km of altitude loss.

sectionType.description: Highlight specific road section types in response for route analysis: toll (toll roads), motorway (highways), tunnel, urban (city areas), country (rural areas), pedestrian (walking paths), etc.

function.description: Calculate optimal routes between two locations. The primary tool for directions, routes, travel time, or distance between places (e.g. 'route from Amsterdam to Berlin', 'how long to drive from A to B'). Returns turn-by-turn directions, distance, travel time, and a map image. Multi-stop routes with 3+ waypoints are handled by tomtom-waypoint-routing; visualizing multiple routes or combining routes with markers/polygons on a single map image is handled by tomtom-dynamic-map.

openingHours.description: List of opening hours for a POI (Points of Interest).Value: `nextSevenDays` Mode shows the opening hours for next week, starting with the current day in the local time of the POI. Usage example: openingHours=nextSevenDays

typeahead.description: Enable autocomplete mode for partial queries. Use for search-as-you-type interfaces.

function.name: tomtom-routing
function.description: Calculate optimal routes between two locations. The primary tool for directions, routes, travel time, or distance between places (e.g. 'route from Amsterdam to Berlin', 'how long to drive from A to B'). Returns turn-by-turn directions, distance, travel time, and a map image. Multi-stop routes with 3+ waypoints are handled by tomtom-waypoint-routing; visualizing multiple routes or combining routes with markers/polygons on a single map image is handled by tomtom-dynamic-map.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to +90). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to +180). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

origin.description: Starting point coordinates. Obtain from geocoding for best results.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to +90). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to +180). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

destination.description: Destination coordinates. Obtain from geocoding for best results.

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): trimmed response with essential fields only, saves tokens. 'full': complete API response with all fields including coordinates, classifications, etc.

traffic.description: Include real-time traffic data for more accurate ETAs and route suggestions.

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. May increase travel time. Options: 'tollRoads','motorways','ferries','unpavedRoads','carpools','alreadyUsedRoads'. Accepts array of string(s).

departAt.description: Departure time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T14:30:00Z'). Cannot be used with arriveAt.

arriveAt.description: Arrival time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T17:00:00Z'). Cannot be used with departAt.

maxAlternatives.description: Number of alternative routes (0-5). More alternatives = more options but larger response.

alternativeType.description: When maxAlternatives is greater than 0, it allows the definition of computing alternative routes: finding routes that are significantly different from the reference route, or finding routes that are better than the reference route. Possible values are: `anyRoute` (returns alternative routes that are significantly different from the reference route.), `betterRoute` (only returns alternative routes that are better than the reference route, according to the given planning criteria (set by routeType). If there is a road block on the reference route, then any alternative that does not contain any blockages will be considered a better route. The summary in the route response will contain information (see the planningReason parameter) about the reason for the better alternative.) Note: The betterRoute value can only be used when reconstructing a reference route. Default value: `anyRoute` Other values: `betterRoute`

language.description: Language code for instructions (e.g., 'en-US', 'de-DE').

computeBestOrder.description: Reorder waypoints for optimization. Use with multiple waypoints to find the most efficient route order.

supportingPoints.description: Additional coordinates that influence the route shape without being stops (format: 'lat,lon;lat,lon').

vehicleHeading.description: Heading of the vehicle in degrees (0-359) for more accurate initial routing.

includeTollPaymentTypes.description: Include toll payment types in the toll section. If a toll section has different toll payment types in its subsections, this toll section is split into multiple toll sections with the toll payment types. Possible values: all(Include toll payment types in the toll section.), none (Do not include toll payment types in the toll section). The value `all` must be used together with sectionType=toll. Default value: none

report.description: Specifies which data should be reported for diagnostic purposes. A possible value is: `effectiveSettings`. Reports the effective parameters or data used when calling the API. In the case of defaulted parameters, the default will be reflected where the parameter was not specified by the caller. Default value: effectiveSettings

routeRepresentation.description: Representation of routes in response: 'polyline' (default, includes points), 'encodedPolyline' (compressed format), 'summaryOnly' (no points), 'none' (with computeBestOrder only). It cannot be used when `maxAlternatives` is set

extendedRouteRepresentation.description: Additional routing data formats to include in the response.

computeTravelTimeFor.description: Calculate travel times for all segments ('all') or none ('none').

hilliness.description: Preference for avoiding hills. Use 'low' for flatter routes.

windingness.description: Preference for avoiding winding roads. Use 'low' for straighter routes.

vehicleMaxSpeed.description: Maximum vehicle speed in km/h for commercial routing.

vehicleWeight.description: Vehicle weight in kg. Important for truck routing restrictions.

vehicleWidth.description: Vehicle width in meters. Used to avoid narrow roads.

vehicleHeight.description: Vehicle height in meters. Used to avoid low bridges.

vehicleLength.description: Vehicle length in meters. Affects maneuverability restrictions.

vehicleCommercial.description: Commercial vehicle flag. Affects road access restrictions.

vehicleAxleWeight.description: Vehicle axle weight in kg for weight-restricted roads.

vehicleNumberOfAxles.description: Number of axles on the vehicle. Used for toll calculations and restrictions.

vehicleLoadType.description: Cargo type for hazardous materials routing.

vehicleAdrTunnelRestrictionCode.description: ADR tunnel restriction code for hazardous materials.

vehicleEngineType.description: Engine type for fuel/energy consumption calculation.

currentChargeInkWh.description: Current EV battery charge in kWh. Required for EV routing.

maxChargeInkWh.description: Maximum EV battery capacity in kWh. Required for EV routing.

constantSpeedConsumptionInkWhPerHundredk.description: EV speed-to-consumption mappings format: '50,8.2:130,21.3' (speed in km/h, consumption in kWh/100km).

auxiliaryPowerInkW.description: Auxiliary power consumption in kW for electric vehicles.

chargeMarginsInkWh.description: Comma-separated charge margins in kWh for route planning.

constantSpeedConsumptionInLitersPerHundr.description: Combustion speed-to-consumption mappings: '50,6.3:130,11.5' (speed in km/h, consumption in L/100km).

currentFuelInLiters.description: Current fuel level in liters for combustion vehicles.

auxiliaryPowerInLitersPerHour.description: Auxiliary power consumption for combustion vehicles in L/hr.

fuelEnergyDensityInMJoulesPerLiter.description: Fuel energy density in megajoules per liter.

consumptionInkWhPerkmAltitudeGain.description: Energy used per km of altitude gain.

recuperationInkWhPerkmAltitudeLoss.description: Energy recovered per km of altitude loss.

sectionType.description: Highlight specific road section types in response for route analysis: toll (toll roads), motorway (highways), tunnel, urban (city areas), country (rural areas), pedestrian (walking paths), etc.

function.name: tomtom-traffic
function.description: Find traffic incidents in an area. The primary tool for questions about traffic, accidents, road closures, congestion, or dangerous road conditions. Returns severity, description, delay and affected roads for each incident. Incident locations are omitted unless response_detail is 'geometry'.

show_ui.description: Request the interactive map widget. Only hosts that support MCP Apps render it, and it returns no coordinates to the caller. Default: false

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): essential fields and point coordinates, no geometry. 'geometry': compact plus a 'geometry' key holding a GeoJSON FeatureCollection ([lon, lat], at most 1,000 vertices per feature); use this to get coordinates to draw or process. 'full': the raw API response, lossless and many times larger.

bbox.description: Bounding box as [minLon, minLat, maxLon, maxLat] (GeoJSON convention). Example: [-74.02, 40.70, -73.96, 40.80] for lower Manhattan. Use smaller areas for better results.

language.description: Language for incident descriptions: 'en-GB', 'de-DE', 'fr-FR', 'es-ES'. Default: 'en-GB'.

categoryFilter.description: Filter by incident categories (comma-separated): '0' (Accident), '1' (Fog), '2' (Dangerous Conditions), '3' (Rain), '4' (Ice), '5' (Lane Restrictions), '6' (Lane Closure), '7' (Road Closure), '8' (Road Works), '9' (Wind), '10' (Flooding), '11' (Detour), '14' (Cluster).

timeValidityFilter.description: Filter incidents by occurrence time. Values: 'present' (current incidents), 'future' (planned incidents). Multiple values comma-separated. Default: 'present'.

maxResults.description: Maximum number of incidents to return (1-1000). Default: 100. When more incidents match, the most severe are returned and the response includes an incidentSummary with full totals.

fields.description: Fields to include in response, nested as in response schema. Default: basic incident data. For all fields use full object notation with incidents{type,geometry{type,coordinates},properties{...}}.

function.name: tomtom-routing
function.description: Calculate optimal routes between two locations. The primary tool for directions, routes, travel time, or distance between places (e.g. 'route from Amsterdam to Berlin', 'how long to drive from A to B'). Returns turn-by-turn directions, distance, travel time, and a map image. Multi-stop routes with 3+ waypoints are handled by tomtom-waypoint-routing; visualizing multiple routes or combining routes with markers/polygons on a single map image is handled by tomtom-dynamic-map.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to +90). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to +180). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

origin.description: Starting point coordinates. Obtain from geocoding for best results.

lat.description: Latitude coordinate (-90 to +90). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

lon.description: Longitude coordinate (-180 to +180). Use precise coordinates from geocoding for best results.

destination.description: Destination coordinates. Obtain from geocoding for best results.

response_detail.description: Response detail level. 'compact' (default): trimmed response with essential fields only, saves tokens. 'full': complete API response with all fields including coordinates, classifications, etc.

traffic.description: Include real-time traffic data for more accurate ETAs and route suggestions.

avoid.description: Route features to avoid. May increase travel time. Options: 'tollRoads','motorways','ferries','unpavedRoads','carpools','alreadyUsedRoads'. Accepts array of string(s).

departAt.description: Departure time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T14:30:00Z'). Cannot be used with arriveAt.

arriveAt.description: Arrival time in ISO format (e.g., '2025-06-24T17:00:00Z'). Cannot be used with departAt.

maxAlternatives.description: Number of alternative routes (0-5). More alternatives = more options but larger response.

alternativeType.description: When maxAlternatives is greater than 0, it allows the definition of computing alternative routes: finding routes that are significantly different from the reference route, or finding routes that are better than the reference route. Possible values are: `anyRoute` (returns alternative routes that are significantly different from the reference route.), `betterRoute` (only returns alternative routes that are better than the reference route, according to the given planning criteria (set by routeType). If there is a road block on the reference route, then any alternative that does not contain any blockages will be considered a better route. The summary in the route response will contain information (see the planningReason parameter) about the reason for the better alternative.) Note: The betterRoute value can only be used when reconstructing a reference route. Default value: `anyRoute` Other values: `betterRoute`

language.description: Language code for instructions (e.g., 'en-US', 'de-DE').

computeBestOrder.description: Reorder waypoints for optimization. Use with multiple waypoints to find the most efficient route order.

supportingPoints.description: Additional coordinates that influence the route shape without being stops (format: 'lat,lon;lat,lon').

vehicleHeading.description: Heading of the vehicle in degrees (0-359) for more accurate initial routing.

includeTollPaymentTypes.description: Include toll payment types in the toll section. If a toll section has different toll payment types in its subsections, this toll section is split into multiple toll sections with the toll payment types. Possible values: all(Include toll payment types in the toll section.), none (Do not include toll payment types in the toll section). The value `all` must be used together with sectionType=toll. Default value: none

report.description: Specifies which data should be reported for diagnostic purposes. A possible value is: `effectiveSettings`. Reports the effective parameters or data used when calling the API. In the case of defaulted parameters, the default will be reflected where the parameter was not specified by the caller. Default value: effectiveSettings

routeRepresentation.description: Representation of routes in response: 'polyline' (default, includes points), 'encodedPolyline' (compressed format), 'summaryOnly' (no points), 'none' (with computeBestOrder only). It cannot be used when `maxAlternatives` is set

extendedRouteRepresentation.description: Additional routing data formats to include in the response.

computeTravelTimeFor.description: Calculate travel times for all segments ('all') or none ('none').

hilliness.description: Preference for avoiding hills. Use 'low' for flatter routes.

windingness.description: Preference for avoiding winding roads. Use 'low' for straighter routes.

vehicleMaxSpeed.description: Maximum vehicle speed in km/h for commercial routing.

vehicleWeight.description: Vehicle weight in kg. Important for truck routing restrictions.

vehicleWidth.description: Vehicle width in meters. Used to avoid narrow roads.

vehicleHeight.description: Vehicle height in meters. Used to avoid low bridges.

vehicleLength.description: Vehicle length in meters. Affects maneuverability restrictions.

vehicleCommercial.description: Commercial vehicle flag. Affects road access restrictions.

vehicleAxleWeight.description: Vehicle axle weight in kg for weight-restricted roads.

vehicleNumberOfAxles.description: Number of axles on the vehicle. Used for toll calculations and restrictions.

vehicleLoadType.description: Cargo type for hazardous materials routing.

vehicleAdrTunnelRestrictionCode.description: ADR tunnel restriction code for hazardous materials.

vehicleEngineType.description: Engine type for fuel/energy consumption calculation.

currentChargeInkWh.description: Current EV battery charge in kWh. Required for EV routing.

maxChargeInkWh.description: Maximum EV battery capacity in kWh. Required for EV routing.

constantSpeedConsumptionInkWhPerHundredk.description: EV speed-to-consumption mappings format: '50,8.2:130,21.3' (speed in km/h, consumption in kWh/100km).

auxiliaryPowerInkW.description: Auxiliary power consumption in kW for electric vehicles.

chargeMarginsInkWh.description: Comma-separated charge margins in kWh for route planning.

constantSpeedConsumptionInLitersPerHundr.description: Combustion speed-to-consumption mappings: '50,6.3:130,11.5' (speed in km/h, consumption in L/100km).

currentFuelInLiters.description: Current fuel level in liters for combustion vehicles.

auxiliaryPowerInLitersPerHour.description: Auxiliary power consumption for combustion vehicles in L/hr.

fuelEnergyDensityInMJoulesPerLiter.description: Fuel energy density in megajoules per liter.

consumptionInkWhPerkmAltitudeGain.description: Energy used per km of altitude gain.

recuperationInkWhPerkmAltitudeLoss.description: Energy recovered per km of altitude loss.

sectionType.description: Highlight specific road section types in response for route analysis: toll (toll roads), motorway (highways), tunnel, urban (city areas), country (rural areas), pedestrian (walking paths), etc.
